Since 0.1.8. The major version stays 0.

### Home
When an app opens on one screen, the other keeps its grid until it can draw the dissolve, and that grid's hint row fades with it (#390). The hero's facts fade with the named game's art. If the name arrives before slow art, the facts wait (#390).

A status chip sits over the tile's rounded rim, above a whole focus ring, including while tiles move or pop into Find. Transfer bars stay inside the tile (#390). A short title that crosses the edge of a tall cover keeps the nearby quiet margin, so the crop does not stop halfway through the logo (#390).

The title and the facts ease from one game to the next as a logo takes the place of a name. A logo with no facts and no open summary stands alone, and the empty card folds away (#393). R3 Info stays while the next game's details load, then goes away if that game has no summary. R3 still opens only the game you are on (#393).

The home music stays steady while the d-pad moves. A and B still dip it (#394).

When B presses OK, that button wears B. A dialog B only closes still says B Close or B Cancel (#393).

### Saves
With no network, both Saves panels say No internet, and the card has a Wi-Fi button (#393).

### Games
A missing BIOS keeps the folder from splitting at a slash, so a path such as RetroArch/system stays together (#393).

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads Home shortcuts and exported `.steam`, `.epic`, `.gog`, `.amazon`, and `.pcgame` files. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
- Android games launched from Foldcade don't record play history, so they don't appear in Recent or Most played.
